description: Two-turn config edit: raise prod workers to 6, then set staging to half of prod's new value; final file judged. EXAM-CANARY-3f1f542b

files.deploy/app.yaml:
service: orders-api
prod:
  region: eu-west-1
  workers: 4
  timeout_s: 30
staging:
  region: eu-west-1
  workers: 2
  timeout_s: 30

turns.prompt: Bump the prod worker count in deploy/app.yaml from 4 to 6.
Now staging. Give it half as many workers as prod has now.

contains:
service: orders-api
prod:
  region: eu-west-1
  workers: 6
  timeout_s: 30
staging:
  region: eu-west-1
  workers: 3
  timeout_s: 30
